\newpage

# Intact vs. ulcerrative - all slides

In this subsection, each figure shows all slides from a single biopsy. 

\newpage
```{r intact+ulcer all, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (b in biopsies) {
  cat("## ", b, "\n")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2skin_"%.%b%.%"_set1.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2skin_"%.%b%.%"_set2.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2skin_"%.%b%.%"_set3.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
  
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2DEJ_"%.%b%.%"_set1.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2DEJ_"%.%b%.%"_set2.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
  cat("\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{output/figures/compare_normal_lesion_dist2DEJ_"%.%b%.%"_set3.png}\\end{figure}\n\\newpage")
}
```
